plan.goal: Show Bankatlal admitting his mistake, comparing Gajanan to Arjuna, declaring no further test needed, and praising Shegaon as blessed by Hari's gift of desirelessness.

turn.text: Bankatlal admits calling Gajanan mad was a mistake and says no further test is needed.

shots.action: camera drifts gently across the two figures
shots.held_pose: Bankatlal gesturing with hand, Damodarpant standing attentive
shots.performance: Bankatlal speaks the admission of mistake

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal Agarwal
dialogue.marathi: ह्या वेडा म्हणालों आपण । ती निःसंशय झाली चुकी
dialogue.meaning_en: Calling him mad was surely our mistake.

staging: STAGING: two men standing on road near Devidas's house

shots.action: camera pushes slowly on Bankatlal's face
shots.held_pose: Bankatlal close-up, eyes fixed, mouth slightly open as if speaking

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal Agarwal
dialogue.marathi: सुभद्रेसाठीं द्वारकेला । अर्जुन ऐसाच वेडा झाला । व्यवहाराचा विसर पडला । करुं लागला भलभलतें
dialogue.meaning_en: For Subhadra, Arjuna went mad in Dwarka; he forgot worldly dealings and started babbling.

staging: STAGING: close-up framing of Bankatlal's face

shots.action: camera pushes slowly on Damodarpant's face
shots.performance: Damodarpant listens as Bankatlal declares no further test needed

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal Agarwal
dialogue.marathi: तैसाच हा ज्ञानजेठी । मुक्तिरुप सुभद्रेसाठीं । वेडा झाला कसवटी । याची आतां घेणें नको
dialogue.meaning_en: Likewise this elder of knowledge became mad for liberation in the form of Subhadra; no need to test him now.

staging: STAGING: close-up framing of Damodarpant's face

dialogue.speaker: unclear
dialogue.marathi: धन्य आपुलें शेगांव । दृष्टी पाहिला योगीराव । "निरिच्छा" हा जहागीरगांव । दिला हरीनें जयाला
dialogue.meaning_en: Blessed is our Shegaon; we saw the king of yogis; desirelessness is the estate Hari gave for victory.
